# Labs for this section

No classroom labs for the classic algorithms are written yet. When they appear they will be step-by-step wiki pages, in the same spirit as the labs on [albertprofe.dev](https://albertprofe.dev){.external target="_blank"}. The exact numbering is still open.

The nine algorithm pages are still short definitions. A first lab will likely sit next to [linear regression](algo-linear-regression.qmd), once that page is filled out.
